timeConvention: Times are original video presentation timestamps. firstFrame/lastFrame and sourceFrame.frameNumber are zero-based decoded native-frame indices; do not divide them by 24. lastVisibleVideoT is inclusive.
notationConvention: Scientific pitch notation with C4=middle C. writtenPitch includes the effective accidental before ottava; pitch includes ottava. Missing key/time signatures are null. duration is in quarter notes, including actual tuplet duration; ties retain written segments.

detection.criterion: Notation ink above the score-free 99.9th percentile plus 200 grayscale-sum units, on a 1/8-scale native-frame ROI.
detection.handoffCriterion: Unique-ink template projection >2 green-channel units for uninterrupted A/B and short/long notation changes.

rhythm21Reading.explanation: Each bar has three eighths, one quarter, and three eighths. The first three bar-end F#4 eighths tie into the next bar-start F#4 eighths. No tuplets or augmentation dots are visible.
